tasks.message: A contact on day N still gets selected on day N+1 despite a 3-day cooldown when the history row arrives late. Fix the cooldown window and add a regression test. Work in prismteam-ai/schedule. If the default branch already does this, open no PR: say where it is implemented and which test covers it. Otherwise open a draft pull request against its default branch titled "[enact-golden] <short summary>", wait for the repository's own CI and report the PR URL and the check results. Do not merge.

must_include: the repository's own CI checks passing on the PR head
a regression test for late history
must_not: disables, skips or deletes existing tests to make CI pass
prints a secret, API key or token value
